headline: Passed resolve on civility, failed ordinance on Legislative Committee duties, found Councilor Mallar violated ethics code, and postponed two housing orders.
summary: The council passed a resolve reaffirming civility and procedural order, approved several routine orders including property deeds and a labor agreement, and passed an ethics code amendment. An ordinance changing the Legislative Committee's duties failed after amendment, two orders on a Bangor Housing Development Corporation project at 205 Corporate Drive were postponed to August 10, 2026, and the council voted that Councilor Wayne Mallar violated three provisions of the ethics code and must undergo training.
decisions: Elected Susan Faloon as Chair Pro Temp.
Suspended the rules to take up Council Resolve 26-245, passed 6-2.
Passed Resolve 26-245 reaffirming the City Council's Commitment to Civility, Procedural Order, and Public Trust, 8-0.
Approved the minutes of the Bangor City Council Regular Meeting of July 13, 2026.
Passed Order 26-238 authorizing execution of a municipal quitclaim deed for real estate at 36 Grove Street.
Passed Order 26-239 authorizing execution of a municipal quitclaim deed for real estate at 166 Larkin Street.
Passed Order 26-240 authorizing the City Manager to execute a collective bargaining agreement with the Amalgamated Transit Union Local 714.
Passed Order 26-241 authorizing the City Manager to enter into a construction contract with DBU Construction, Inc. for horizontal directional drilling under I-95 for sewer improvements.
Passed a motion to amend Ordinance 26-222 by substitution, 6-2.
Failed a motion for passage of Ordinance 26-222 as amended, vote 0-8.
Passed Ordinance 26-237 amending Chapter 33, Code of Ethics, to add sections 33-22 and 33-23, 8-0.
Approved the Special Amusement License application of Pike and Peppard, LLC d/b/a Barliman's, 2 Hammond Street.
Approved the Special Amusement License application of American Cruise Lines, Inc. d/b/a American Independence and American Constitution, Float Dock 5, Bangor Wharf.
Postponed Order 26-242, a Credit Enhancement Agreement with Bangor Housing Development Corporation for property at 205 Corporate Drive, to the August 10, 2026 City Council Meeting, 8-0.
Postponed Order 26-243, creating a Tax Increment Financing District for affordable housing at 205 Corporate Drive, to the August 10, 2026 City Council Meeting, 8-0.
Passed Order 26-244 finding Councilor Wayne Mallar violated three provisions of the City's Ethics Code and imposing a requirement to undergo training, 5-2.
